subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who can use either hand with ease
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ambidextrous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Meanings of the words:
 
 
• 1) **Gregarious** - fond of company; sociable.
 
• 2) **Virtuoso** - a person highly skilled in music or another artistic pursuit.
 
• 3) **Pedantic **- excessively concerned with minor details or rules; overly academic or formal.
 
• 4) **Ambidextrous** - able to use both hands with equal ease.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ambidextrous**.
